purpose: Frozen inputs for BENCHMARK.md §4 criterion S3. Amendment A-003 in reviews/BENCHMARK-AMENDMENTS.md.

policy.gate: median over tasks of (Arm B modeled dollars / Arm A modeled dollars) — median of per-task ratios, never a ratio of aggregates
policy.scope: every billed critic and defender invocation in the arm, including malformed-output retries
policy.excluded: artifact construction and contamination audit — shared per-task overhead, incurred once regardless of arm
policy.retroactivity: NEVER update historical task costs when public rates change later; this card is frozen for all 25 tasks
policy.labelling: these figures are MODELED API-EQUIVALENT cost, not observed billed cost

anthropic.identitySource: session configuration — the model this harness runs under, recorded in each task's run record
anthropic.rateSource: Anthropic model pricing, retrieved via the bundled claude-api skill reference, 2026-08-09
anthropic.derivation: cacheRead = 0.1 x freshInput; cacheWrite5m = 1.25 x freshInput; cacheWrite1h = 2.0 x freshInput — Anthropic's published multipliers

tokenClassMapping.fallback: when usage.cache_creation is absent, bill usage.cache_creation_input_tokens at the 1h rate — the conservative (higher) of the two TTL rates

openai.identitySource: EVIDENCE-BASED, not a chosen convention: turn_context.model in the Codex CLI's own rollout session logs under ~/.codex/sessions/, recorded independently for all six Arm B runs (T01-T06), unanimous, cli_version 0.147.0
openai.derivation: freshInput, cacheRead (published as 'cached input') and output are read directly from the rate card. The card publishes NO separate cache-write rate, so cache-write tokens are billed at the fresh-input rate — the conservative choice, since any real cache-write discount would only lower Arm B.

tokenClassMapping.freshInput: tokenUsage.last.inputTokens MINUS tokenUsage.last.cachedInputTokens — cachedInputTokens is a SUBSET of inputTokens in this protocol, and double-counting it is exactly the error corrected by the T02-T06 erratum

subscriptionNote: Codex ran under a ChatGPT subscription during this benchmark, so its OBSERVED billed cost is subscription-flat and its marginal cash outlay is zero. Zero is not used in the S3 gate: it describes this deployment's billing arrangement rather than the resource cost of the council, and it is the convention that flatters Arm B. Modeled API-equivalent cost is gated; subscription marginal cost is reported separately as zero and never gated.
